assessment.reason: Supervision confirmed only two "Serves" judgments (both for the zero-UUID catch-all), while the majority of specific requirements—client display, archiving, full output, persistence, input acceptance, and the two-decimal display—were marked DoesNotServe, and several changes were misattributed (cosmetic import reorders credited to input acceptance, a catch-all e2e file). The work appears to have implemented much of the functionality, but the attribution and naming of requirements to changes is weak, leaving a person to verify most requirements manually.
